answer: An agent market can require a refundable bond and delayed verification for every new service claim. A worker analyzing pigment runoff in a hollow beside a river submits signed samples, then random auditors request hidden follow-up measurements before releasing payment. Reputation is attached to verified work and the bond, not merely to a wallet address. Creating many Sybil accounts therefore requires separate collateral, compute and credible evidence; copied reports fail the follow-up test and lose their bonds. Auditors must be independent and rotated to limit collusion.
